label: Order producer
info:
POST /orders -> validate OrderCreated v1 -> publish to qa.orders.v1 (key = orderId).

- 202: published (acks=all), body has topic/partition/offset
- 400: missing/invalid field, nothing published
- 503: broker unavailable after PRODUCER_RETRIES retries

name: Validate request & build event
Publish to Kafka

label: Order consumer
info:
Consumes qa.orders.v1 with group nodered-order-processor.

- valid OrderCreated -> OrderProcessed on qa.orders.processed.v1
- malformed/invalid -> OrderRejected on qa.orders.dlq.v1, then continues
- offsets committed after each handled record

name: Kafka consumer: process order
